capsule_audit.missing_domain: Neither adjacent capsule stores per-voice SPU register snapshots.
capsule_audit.disposition: Use the capsules only as adjacent SFX controls; use pristine ASM and existing isolated SPU-key-on evidence for ownership and lifecycle. No new replay is needed for row closure.

positive_sfx_mapping.formula: index=id-16; program=index>>7; tone=index&0x7f; VAB tone selects VAG
positive_sfx_mapping.global_bank_range: For positive IDs 16 through 58, GLOBAL VAG equals id-15.
positive_sfx_mapping.runtime_control: ID 0x35 selected tone 37 and GLOBAL VAG 38; playback was confirmed by SPU key-on rather than the dispatch return value.

voice_ownership.primary_pool: Eight entries at 0x80089860, stride 8; descriptor at +0 and voice id at +4; -1 means free.
voice_ownership.allocation: Reuse a matching descriptor, otherwise use a free slot; a full pool drops the request.
voice_ownership.lifecycle_tick: 0x80043284 expires companion timers, keys voices off, reconciles primary ownership, and polls all 24 SPU key states.
voice_ownership.initialization: 0x80044c5c clears both eight-entry structures and registers 0x80043284 as the audio tick callback.
voice_ownership.hard_reset: 0x80043500 keys off all 24 voices and clears the eight timer and ownership slots.

music_selection.selector: Gameplay reset reads scene/music id at 0x8008245c, passes id-1 to looping music, except a flag at 0x8008225c selects packed id 0x15.
music_selection.transport: 0x8004699c sets XA file/channel filter, mode 0xe8, location, ReadS, and demute. Looping is implemented by software polling and restart.

vab_inventory.scope: All GLOBAL and extracted level VH headers were parsed; counts are guarded by the C analyzer.

pause_and_reset.pause: Existing A18 runtime evidence shows XA/CD read position stops while paused, while pause-menu SFX remain available.
pause_and_reset.scene_reset: Scene flow clears or replaces 0x8008245c; the selected music id is runtime scene state, not persistent save state.
pause_and_reset.sequencer: The linked PsyQ SEQ path has no game callers; runtime probes observed zero hits while SsUtKeyOn remained active.

causal_controls: B08 control produced three key-ons near grant; NOPing the SFX call left one, so that call accounts for two real SPU voices.
B06 executed the SFX call once at its grant frame; one separate failed audio probe is excluded from positive evidence.
